description: Update an existing QR code's properties. Use this when the user wants to change where a QR code points to, rename it, or enable/disable it. Destination URL changes only work for dynamic URL-based types (url, pdf, menu, app-store, social). Name and active status can be changed for any QR code type.

destinationUrl.description: New destination URL. Only works for dynamic URL-based types (url, pdf, menu, app-store, social). The physical QR code does not need reprinting.

id.description: The unique identifier of the QR code to update. Obtain this from quality_qr_list or quality_qr_create responses.

isActive.description: Set to false to disable the QR code (scans will stop redirecting). Set to true to re-enable it.

name.description: New human-readable name for the QR code.

name: quality_qr_update
